story.iWant: delete clips I don't need from the timeline
story.soThat: I can remove mistakes or unwanted footage
story.tasks: - Add removeClip action to timelineStore (filter clip, recalculate gaps, update duration) - Create DeleteTool component with Delete button UI - Implement keyboard shortcut handlers (Delete/Backspace keys) - Implement gap-closing logic for remaining clips - Handle playhead position after deletion - Verify media library persistence (clip remains in library) - Add visual feedback for delete operation - Test delete functionality end-to-end

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: User can select a clip on timeline AC2: Delete button or keyboard shortcut (Delete/Backspace key) removes selected clip AC3: Remaining clips automatically shift left to close gap AC4: Timeline updates playhead position if it was on deleted clip AC5: Deleted clip disappears from timeline but remains in media library AC6: User can delete multiple clips sequentially

docs.doc: Delete operation removes clip from timeline. Remaining clips automatically shift left to close gap. Deleted clip remains in media library (timeline and media library are independent). Must support keyboard shortcuts (Delete/Backspace).
User selects clip → clicks Delete button or presses Delete/Backspace → removeClip(clipId) called → Store removes clip from array → Remaining clips shift left → Timeline re-renders.
EditTools folder at src/renderer/components/EditTools/ for DeleteTool.tsx component. State mutations in src/renderer/store/timelineStore.ts. Keyboard event handlers in Timeline.tsx.
Application shall allow deletion of clips from timeline. NFR001: Timeline UI shall maintain 30+ fps responsiveness with 10 or more clips loaded.

constraints.constraint: Zustand immutability: removeClip creates new clips array, never mutates existing array
NFR001: Delete operation must complete within 16ms (synchronous, UI remains 60fps)
Renderer-only operation: No IPC calls, pure state mutation in renderer process
Timeline and media library are independent: deleting from timeline doesn't remove from media library
After deletion, remaining clips must shift left to close gap (recalculate startTime sequentially)

tests.standards: Use Vitest testing framework. Unit tests for removeClip action in timelineStore.test.ts. Test state immutability, gap-closing logic, totalDuration recalculation. Use describe/it/expect pattern. Manual testing for keyboard shortcuts.

ideas.idea: Test removeClip action removes clip from array immutably
Manual test: Click Delete button → verify selected clip removed
Manual test: Press Delete key → verify selected clip removed
Manual test: Press Backspace key → verify selected clip removed
Test gap-closing: Timeline [0, 5, 10], delete middle clip → result [0, 5] (second clip startTime shifts from 10 to 5)
Test playhead adjustment: if playhead on deleted clip, move to clip's startTime
Manual test: Delete clip from timeline, verify it still appears in media library
Manual test: Re-add deleted clip from media library to timeline → verify it works
Manual test: Delete multiple clips sequentially → verify each deletion works correctly
Test delete last clip → timeline becomes empty, totalDuration = 0, playhead = 0
